indicators.note: Server-RDIMMs are scarcely available and confirmed shipment quantities are increasingly restricted.
UDIMM availability is broadly adequate; 32 GB UDIMMs are materially cheaper than comparable 32 GB ECC registered modules.
Enterprise SSD availability is as constrained as server memory; when no inventory is available, quoted lead times are typically 6–10 weeks.
Enterprise SSD supplier pricing is currently being increased on a recurring 4–6 week cadence; no uniform percentage magnitude is asserted.

Stripe's investor communication identifies 1 January 2026 as the start of a material AI-driven economic phase change, alongside strong H1 growth and rapidly scaling AI-native activity. Stripe's OpenRouter acquisition adds another observation point into model and agent usage. MT·AI treats this as leading evidence for AI-demand acceleration, not as proof of AGI or a technological singularity.
